skill_friction: AskCoworker I proposed a wrong business-day formula (+3 then weekend shift gives wrong dates for Thu/Fri) and R/T made wrong platform claims (record-triggered 'updated to meet condition' not firing on create; Task creatable for inactive owner; orphaned Tasks on delete). SKILL.md says fix from evidence, but these are platform-behavior claims no allowed query can test, so they rest on the author's own documented-behavior knowledge; the skill gives no way to ground such corrections beyond tagging them assumption (documented platform behavior).

Rule 3 and the response table say facts from a 'prior session' must be verified; AskCoworker labelled nearly every claim '[Verified: prior session]' even for facts I sent in the same message, which makes the echoed-fact exemption hard to apply mechanically.

Section 7 requires tests from the inventory mapped to behaviors, but for a flow-only design the skill does not say whether a FlowTest component should be in the inventory by default or whether recommended verification is enough; I chose recommended verification and noted Flow Test as a conditional deployment need.
Org verification guidance has no note on BusinessHours semantics (00:00-00:00 = 24 hours) or Holiday, which mattered for a business-days requirement.
